headlines.title: Burnham to unveil public body to invest in electricity grid
headlines.summary: The prime minister will say he wants to reduce energy costs in his first conference speech as Labour leader.

headlines.title: TotalEnergies raises buybacks and pledges higher dividends as oil trades around $100
headlines.summary: TotalEnergies will buy back $2.5 billion (€2.2bn) of its own shares in the fourth quarter, up from $1.5 billion (€1.3bn) authorised for the third, and raise its dividend by more than 5% a year through 2030, as high oil prices boost the French energy giant’s earnings.

headlines.title: Warning more homes will be uninsurable due to flood risk
headlines.summary: Aviva boss Amanda Blanc said England was "for sure" building homes that might be uninsurable at some point in the future.

headlines.title: Uzbekistan bets on tax breaks and new rules to become Central Asia’s tech gateway
headlines.summary: A new business framework is intended to let foreign companies test innovative products, recruit international specialists and expand across regional markets. Investors see opportunities, while authorities finalise the rules ahead of a planned launch in early 2027.

headlines.summary: Bridget Phillipson also throws her weight behind caps on political party spending limits.

headlines.title: Unis are offering degrees in content creation for £30,000. But are they worth it?
headlines.summary: Content creation degrees aim to help people make money from their social media posts.

headlines.title: US and China list $30bn worth of goods for tariff cuts, what it could mean for Europe
headlines.summary: Washington has published lists of goods the US and China could tax at lower rates under their 30-for-30 framework, covering about $30bn (€26.3bn) in annual trade each way. No rates or start date have been set, but US pork, dairy and whiskey on Beijing's list could squeeze European exports.

headlines.title: UK tries to stop Trump's diesel export ban
headlines.summary: John Healey said the government is in talks with the US over Donald Trump's threat to stop exports.

headlines.title: EU pushes China to accept import quotas in bid to rebalance trade
headlines.summary: Brussels is pressing Beijing to accept quotas on Chinese exports as negotiations enter their final stretch, with the EU threatening trade measures unless tangible progress is made by next month.

headlines.title: Where are salaries and job opportunities highest in Portugal?
headlines.summary: Information technology remains one of the most attractive fields in the Portuguese job market, offering high average salaries and strong job creation, according to Randstad's latest Salary Trends Study.

headlines.title: Northern Ireland leader accused of joining mob to block Protestant parade
headlines.summary: Unionists demand criminal consequences for First Minister Michelle O’Neill of Sinn Féin — who joined the road blockade against the Orange Order — as Northern Ireland’s government threatens to unravel.

headlines.summary: The US-Israel war with Iran has caused fuel prices to soar due to disruption of global oil supplies.

trend_headline: 고유가와 무역 갈등이 덮친 유럽 에너지·수출 방어선
summary: 100달러를 웃도는 국제유가와 미국의 디젤 수출 중단 위협이 맞물리며 유럽 에너지 안보에 경고등이 켜졌습니다. 여기에 EU와 중국 간의 무역 긴장으로 프랑스 코냐크 등 주요 수출 섹터가 타격을 입고 있으며, 독일 자동차 기업들의 대규모 리콜까지 겹쳐 실물경제 부담이 가중되고 있습니다.
key_points: 총에너지(TotalEnergies)는 100달러대 고유가 호실적을 바탕으로 4분기 자사주 매입 규모를 25억 달러로 확대
미국의 디젤 수출 제한 검토와 중동발 공급 차질로 영국 등 유럽 내 디젤 가격이 사상 최고치 경신
EU의 대중국 수입 할당제 압박 및 무역 분쟁 여파로 프랑스 코냐크 등 수출 주도 산업이 직격탄
